appliedUpdates.description: Updated architecture.md to reflect that findContactsByCompanyId now exists in contacts-repo.ts (removed outdated 'Note' saying it was missing).

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add convention: when sections show prior data during rerun (opacity-50), apply pointer-events-none consistently across all sections to prevent user interaction with stale data. Currently ResearchSection has it but ContactsSection and ScoringSection do not.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Feature polish-cross-area-flows fixed ResearchSection to show prior data at opacity-50 during rerun (matching ContactsSection/ScoringSection), but added pointer-events-none which the other sections lack. This creates an inconsistency in interaction behavior during reruns.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add note: when calculating derived data (e.g., outreach recommendations), ensure scoring weights are sourced from scoringConfig rather than DEFAULT_WEIGHTS to avoid divergence when users configure custom weights.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The outreach section's recommendation ranking in getBriefData (lib/actions/briefs.ts) uses DEFAULT_WEIGHTS for calculateTotalScore, while the scoring section uses scoringConfig.weights when available. If a user sets custom weights, the ranking order may differ between the scoring display and outreach recommendations.
